depth_targets.title: Rotation configuration (enable/disable, on-demand)
limitations: Vyomi has no Lambda runtime wired to Secrets Manager and no background scheduler: RotateSecret carries the current value forward into a fresh version — the same AWSCURRENT/AWSPREVIOUS transition a real rotation Lambda performs — but it never invokes a rotation Lambda function and automatic rotation never fires on its own; use 'Rotate secret immediately' to actually rotate.

depth_targets.title: Resource permissions (resource policy)
limitations: The resource policy document is stored and returned exactly as written, but Vyomi does not evaluate it — it never denies or allows access to a secret based on policy content.

depth_targets.title: Encryption key (KmsKeyId)
limitations: KmsKeyId is stored and returned exactly as configured, but Vyomi does not use it to actually encrypt the secret value — SecretString/SecretBinary are never re-encrypted under the referenced KMS key.

depth_targets.title: Pick an existing RDS/DocumentDB/Redshift database instance
limitations: The wizard's browse-and-select database instance table isn't modeled; enter connection details (user name, password, server address) manually instead — the credential secret itself is stored and retrievable exactly like any other secret.

depth_targets.title: Cross-Region replication
limitations: Replicating a secret into other AWS Regions isn't modeled — there's no second Region's store to replicate into. The secret itself is real and single-Region.
